_comment: Per-model prompt variants. The first entry whose 'match' (case-insensitive substring of the model file name) matches wins. tool_format: 'auto' = native OpenAI tools when the model's chat template supports them, else the <tool_call> text protocol; 'native' / 'text' force one; 'json' = every step is a JSON-schema-constrained tool call (grammar), for models that will not emit parseable tool calls. temperature overrides the agent's sampling temperature.

variants.notes: R1 distills have no tool-call template and think inside <think> tags; use the text protocol and strip reasoning.
Measured: never emits parseable native tool calls (DECISIONS D5); JSON-schema constrained steps work.
